text.text_excerpt: I stayed at the Springhill Suites New Orleans for 4 nights. It is conveniently located 2 minutes from the Ernest Morial Convention Center, the National WWII Museum, the Riverwalk Mall and many restaurants, cafes and bars. A 4 minute taxi ride or a 15 minute walk will get you to the French Quarter. Harrah's Casino and the fine Shops at Canal Place are within walking distance as well. Complimentary hot breakfast is available every morning along with complimentary wifi and complimentary business newspapers including the Wall Street Journal & USA Today. A very modern hotel located near the Convention Center. Stayed here for 3 nights in room #237. 2 Queen Beds and an elegant sofa bed from West Elm. The lobby is very open and welcoming. The front desk is filled Chupa Chups lollipops! My favorite is the chocolate/vanilla. It's free! It was one of the kind treats that makes you feel so welcome. There is also cold water in the lobby and hot coffee by the elevator. One of the best things that I enjoyed here is the breakfast that served. I don't know what time they start serving but I do know when they end. One the weekends they stop serving breakfast at 10am. Weekdays 9am. It's free. It's part of the perks for staying here. I had a pleasant, 3-nights stay at this SpringHill Suites. This property seems to have been recently refreshed and I gotta say, the modern design looks great! Our suite was spacious and impeccably clean. There was a separate living room area with a wet bar, and the room had abundant natural lighting. Even though there were still elements of "corporate design" (i.e. bland wall art, standard desk chair etc), there were some unexpected elements. For example, I loved the West Elm Emery Sofa. It was understated in style, and so comfy and could have easily accommodated for two more people. I enjoyed the large makeup mirror and walk in shower as well.
